description: Assemblyman Jake Blumencranz is leading Long Island into a safer, more affordable future for families, senior citizens and young people. From working to lower the rising cost of living to improving educational opportunities for all students, Jake is taking on the issues that affect every day New Yorkers and replacing the culture of extremism and political polarization in Albany with one of action for a better tomorrow.
